"""Web-path parity e2e for mindmap workflows (WP5-T2b)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not os.getenv("MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN"),
    reason="MEM_MCP_TEST_DSN not set",
)


def _cookies(raw: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"mem_session": raw}


async def _add_member(pg_pool: Any, team: UUID, tenant: UUID, role: str = "member") -> None:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        await conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO team_role_assignments (parent_team_id, member_kind, member_id, role_id, status, assigned_by_user_id)
            SELECT $1, 'user', $2, (SELECT id FROM roles_catalog WHERE role_key = $3 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 'active', $2
            ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
            """,
            team,
            tenant,
            role,
        )


async def _seed_map(
    pg_pool: Any,
    owner_tenant: UUID,
    team: UUID,
    wf_id: UUID | None,
    stage: str = "todo",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            root = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Root', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'question', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                owner_tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-root-{uuid4()}",
            )
            child = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Child', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'note', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                owner_tenant,
                team,
                f"hash-child-{uuid4()}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)",
                root,
                owner_tenant,
                team,
                "Map",
                "live",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'position')",
                child,
                root,
                owner_tenant,
            )
            map_key = f"map-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO slugs (memory_id, team_id, resource_type, slug, title) VALUES ($1,$2,'map',$3,$4)",
                root,
                team,
                map_key,
                "Map",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO work_items (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, kind, status, assignee_id, created_by, workflow_id, current_stage)
                VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'story','todo',NULL,$3,$5,$6)
                """,
                child,
                root,
                owner_tenant,
                team,
                wf_id,
                stage,
            )
    return {"root": root, "child": child, "map_key": map_key}

async def test_web_workflow_parity(
    client: Any,
    pg_pool: Any,
    user_with_workspace: Any,
    other_user_same_workspace: Any,
    db_session: Any,
) -> None:
    owner = user_with_workspace
    signer = other_user_same_workspace
    owner_cookie = _cookies(owner["session"])
    signer_cookie = _cookies(signer["session"])

    # team owned by workspace user
    r = client.post("/api/web/teams", json={"name": "Team"}, cookies=owner_cookie)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    team_id = UUID(r.json()["team"]["id"])

    # add signer as member
    client.post(
        f"/api/web/teams/{team_id}/members",
        json={"tenant_id": str(signer["tenant_id"])},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    await _add_member(pg_pool, team_id, signer["tenant_id"], "member")

    # create workflow via web endpoint
    stages = [
        {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True, "is_terminal": False},
        {"name": "done", "ordinal": 1, "is_initial": False, "is_terminal": True},
        {"name": "other", "ordinal": 2, "is_initial": False, "is_terminal": False},
    ]
    transitions = [
        {
            "from_stage": "todo",
            "to_stage": "done",
            "requires_reason": True,
            "requires_signoff": False,
            "signoff_min": 1,
        },
        {
            "from_stage": "todo",
            "to_stage": "other",
            "requires_reason": False,
            "requires_signoff": True,
            "signoff_min": 1,
            "signoff_roles": ["member"],
        },
    ]
    cr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/teams/{team_id}/workflow",
        json={"name": "wf", "stages": stages, "transitions": transitions},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert cr.status_code == 200, cr.text
    wf_id = UUID(cr.json()["workflow_id"])
    # activate
    ar = client.post(
        f"/api/web/teams/{team_id}/workflow/{wf_id}/activate",
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert ar.status_code in (200, 400), ar.text

    seeded = await _seed_map(pg_pool, owner["tenant_id"], team_id, wf_id)
    map_key = seeded["map_key"]
    node_id = seeded["child"]

    # board-list carries fields
    br = client.get(f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key}/work-items", cookies=owner_cookie)
    assert br.status_code == 200
    bdata = br.json()
    assert bdata["team_id"] == str(team_id)
    assert len(bdata["items"]) >= 1
    item = bdata["items"][0]
    for k in ("node_id", "team_id", "current_stage", "allowed_moves", "blocked_reason", "pending_signoff"):
        assert k in item, k

    # no-signoff move
    mr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key}/work-items/{node_id}/move",
        json={"to_stage": "done", "reason": "finished", "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert mr.status_code == 200, mr.text
    mdata = mr.json()
    assert mdata["status"] if "status" in mdata else True
    # propose output has current_stage
    # DB check
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id
        )
    assert row["current_stage"] == "done"

    # signoff-gated: need fresh item
    seeded2 = await _seed_map(pg_pool, owner["tenant_id"], team_id, wf_id)
    map_key2 = seeded2["map_key"]
    node_id2 = seeded2["child"]

    # propose
    pr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key2}/work-items/{node_id2}/move",
        json={"to_stage": "other", "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert pr.status_code == 200, pr.text
    pdata = pr.json()
    assert pdata.get("awaiting_signoff") is True
    req_id = pdata.get("request_id")
    assert req_id is not None
    # current_stage unchanged
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id2
        )
    assert row["current_stage"] == "todo"

    # sign with signer cookie
    sr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key2}/work-items/{node_id2}/signoff",
        json={"request_id": req_id, "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=signer_cookie,
    )
    assert sr.status_code == 200, sr.text
    # current_stage advances
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id2
        )
    assert row["current_stage"] == "other"

    # owner-only signoff keeps pending: create new request
    seeded3 = await _seed_map(pg_pool, owner["tenant_id"], team_id, wf_id)
    map_key3 = seeded3["map_key"]
    node_id3 = seeded3["child"]
    pr3 = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key3}/work-items/{node_id3}/move",
        json={"to_stage": "other", "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert pr3.status_code == 200
    req_id3 = pr3.json()["request_id"]
    # owner signs (proposer) -> should not count; request stays pending
    orr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key3}/work-items/{node_id3}/signoff",
        json={"request_id": req_id3, "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    # may be error or no-op; either way current_stage unchanged
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        row = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id = $1", node_id3
        )
    assert row["current_stage"] == "todo"

    # signoff role restriction: signer with out-of-role? signer is member (allowed). Use owner as out-of-role signer on a member-restricted transition? owner not in signoff_roles -> not_eligible
    seeded4 = await _seed_map(pg_pool, owner["tenant_id"], team_id, wf_id)
    map_key4 = seeded4["map_key"]
    node_id4 = seeded4["child"]
    pr4 = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key4}/work-items/{node_id4}/move",
        json={"to_stage": "other", "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    req_id4 = pr4.json()["request_id"]
    orr2 = client.post(
        f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key4}/work-items/{node_id4}/signoff",
        json={"request_id": req_id4, "team_id": str(team_id)},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert orr2.status_code == 400
    assert orr2.json()["detail"]["code"] == "not_eligible"

    # remap unmapped
    rr = client.post(
        f"/api/web/teams/{team_id}/workflow/remap",
        json={"map_key": map_key, "mappings": {"done": "done"}},
        cookies=owner_cookie,
    )
    assert rr.status_code == 200

    # pending signoffs endpoint
    ps = client.get(
        f"/api/web/teams/{team_id}/workflow/pending-signoffs", cookies=owner_cookie
    )
    assert ps.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(ps.json(), list)

    # 401 without cookie
    assert client.get(f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key}/work-items").status_code == 401
    assert (
        client.post(
            f"/api/web/mindmaps/{map_key}/work-items/{node_id}/move",
            json={"to_stage": "done", "reason": "x", "team_id": str(team_id)},
        ).status_code
        == 401
    )
